children: said on Tuesday it has adjusted the lower auto rejection limit to apply to stocks in the 11 rupiah to 14 rupiah price range, to 1 rupiah from 7%.
The adjustment is part of efforts to ensure trading is orderly, fair and efficient and supports better price discovery, the exchange said. The policy is effective Tuesday.
